summary.text:
The team held an architecture review of the event pipeline for billing events. They compared Kafka with a managed queue. Only per-customer ordering is required, which the managed queue handles with message groups, and the team did not want the ops cost of running Kafka.

They then discussed whether to keep the event schema in JSON or move to protobuf. They agreed to stay on JSON and revisit when volume is ten times higher. Marco pointed out that an ADR was needed, and Priya asked Tom to write it.

Decisions:
- Use the managed queue for billing events, no Kafka.
- Keep JSON for the event schema; revisit at ten times current volume.

Actions:
- Tom Okafor: write the ADR for the queue decision, by next review.

summary.text:
The team compared Kafka with the managed queue for billing events. Tom said only per-customer ordering is needed, which the managed queue supports with message groups. Marco ruled out running Kafka ourselves because of the ops cost.

The group also reviewed the event schema format. Tom proposed staying with JSON for now and revisiting protobuf when volume is ten times higher, and Priya settled it.

Decisions: Use the managed queue, not Kafka, for billing events. Keep the event schema in JSON.
Actions: Tom Okafor to write the ADR for the queue decision by next review.

summary.text:
The team triaged four bugs and issues. Jun Park reported an Android crash on rotation on the payment screen, affecting about 200 users since Monday. Jun will look at it today.

Tom Okafor reported that password reset emails arrive about ten minutes late. He traced it to the mail queue worker, which runs every ten minutes. Lena suggested sending reset emails immediately, and Tom agreed to change it.

Lena Fischer will fix the dashboard showing the wrong currency symbol for Swiss francs. The cause is a hardcoded symbol map. Jun also reported that the export button does nothing on Safari. Lena could not reproduce it, so Jun will ask the customer for their Safari version.

Decisions:
Password reset emails will be sent immediately rather than through the queue worker.
Actions:
- Jun Park: fix the Android rotation crash on the payment screen (today).
- Tom Okafor: change password reset emails to send right away.
- Lena Fischer: fix the Swiss franc symbol on the dashboard.

summary.text:
The team ran a daily status round, repeated several times in the transcript. Lena is still working on the dashboard charts and it is going fine. Tom is mostly reviewing pull requests and is not blocked. Marco's on call was quiet, with two pages that were both false alarms. Jun is testing the new build on older phones, which looks good so far.

Marco traced the false alarms to the disk alert threshold, which is at seventy percent, and agreed to raise it to eighty five. Jun found one real bug: push notifications don't open the right screen on iOS, and will fix the deep link this sprint.

Priya noted the team agreed to freeze features on the twentieth for the audit. Lena asked for someone to pair on the chart accessibility review and Tom offered to do it on Wednesday.

Decisions:
- Freeze features on the twentieth for the audit
- Raise the disk alert threshold to eighty five

Actions:
- Marco Silva: raise the disk alert threshold to eighty five
- Jun Park: fix the iOS notification deep link this sprint
- Tom Okafor: pair with Lena on the chart accessibility review on Wednesday
